name: Counterfactual Variant 9
task:
Please complete the following four-stage scenario analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Baseline Calculation ===
A streaming service: 5,000 subscribers at $12/month. Content licensing: $30,000/month. Bandwidth: $0.02/stream, avg 50 streams/user/month. Calculate monthly profit.

=== Stage 2: Single-Variable Change ===
Increase marketing spend by 20% while keeping other factors constant. Calculate new net revenue.

=== Stage 3: Multi-Variable Change ===
Increase marketing spend by 20% AND increase average order value by 10%. Calculate new net revenue.

=== Stage 4: Comparison and Recommendation ===
Compare the three scenarios. Recommend the best approach.
